newsitem.title: ITALY: IMI-Sigeco starts quoting 5-yr BTP futures.
newsitem.headline: IMI-Sigeco starts quoting 5-yr BTP futures.

text.p: Milan broker IMI-Sigeco on Monday began quoting five-year Btp futures on the screen-based Milan futures market MIF with a maximum 10 basis point spread between bid and offer price and for amounts up to 100 lots.
The securities house, owned by credit agency IMI, said in a statement it would be quoting the futures for a three-week period.
In recent months trading in the five-year contract has virtually ground to a halt with a daily average volume of only 40 lots changing hands and no open interest.

IMI-Sigeco said that its move was aimed at "providing a reference point for similar initiatives by the other 26 MIF market makers and stimulating the presence on the five-year contract of all the other operators and in particular of investors." -- Milan newsroom +392 66129589
